segments.text:
V. 21.
Neither ſhall they ſay, Lo here, or lo there—This ſhall not be the Language of thoſe, who are, or ſhall be ſent by me, to declare the Coming of my Kingdom. For behold the kingdom of God is within or among you—Look not for it in diſtant Times or remote Places: It is now in the midſt of you: It is come: It is preſent in the Soul of every true Believer: It is a ſpiritual Kingdom, an internal Principle. Wherever it exiſts, it exiſts in the Heart.
